messages:
Nora Blake: FYI - ZenithHealth (ZH-207) hit a partial activation failure during their bulk import at 02:12 UTC. Renewal check-in in ~3 weeks. Need a short customer update + office hours invite and an exec 1-liner.
Evan Liu: please paste the top error lines
Nora Blake: support snapshot: `ingest-proxy -> 502 gateway` and `shard cache warm timeout` repeated. Attaching logs to ticket.
Maya Fernandez: quick read: looks like cache warm contention plus continuous batching overload on their shard. Eng to confirm mitigation.
InfraBot: Incident created INC-ZH-207-2026 severity=P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-response.
Evan Liu: mitigation plan: (1) disable continuous batching for ZH-207 (2) warm their shard with higher concurrency (3) replay failed chunks with smaller batch size. Steps 1+2 in ~30-45m; replay ~2-3h.
Nora Blake: Maya, draft a 3-line customer note with ETA and two office hour slots and ask for priority seat IDs.
Maya Fernandez: Draft -> `Hi ZenithHealth  were aware some activations from your scheduled import failed this morning. Root cause: cache warm-up contention during a high-volume batch. What were doing: disabling tenant batching (ETA ~45m), warming your shard and replaying failed items (ETA ~3h). We will dedupe and rate-limit replays to avoid duplicates. Office hours: Wed 09:00 PT or Wed 18:00 CET. Well apply a temporary account credit and follow up with an RCA within 72 hours. Please reply with priority seat IDs.`
CSM - Hugo: Sent to customer (ticket #94277). Customer replied: "Prioritize seats 4122,4123. Wed 09:00 PT works."
Nora Blake: Actions: @Evan disable batching + start cache warm (ETA 45m). @Hugo send office hours invite and flag renewal owner. @Maya prepare exec blurb for buyer. Credits to be applied within 24h.
Evan Liu: Change applied: continuous batching disabled for ZH-207 at 1839991500. Cache warm starting now.
Evan Liu: Replay started; first tranche lifted activations from ~52% -> ~85%. Monitoring in place; will post +60m update.
Maya Fernandez: Exec blurb suggestion -> "Partial ingestion disruption for ZenithHealth due to cache warm-up contention during a large import. Immediate mitigations applied; replay and validation are underway; temporary credit and RCA committed."
Nora Blake: Timeline: customer-friendly summary in 8h, full RCA draft in 72h, credits within 24h. Keeping this thread as the single source for customer-facing updates. React when seen. :white_check_mark:
Evan Liu: :white_check_mark:
Maya Fernandez: :thumbsup:
